_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Anda adolah Pamain {player_id} dalam permainan Liar's Dice {num_players} pamain.
Aturan:
- Pado giliran Anda, Anda buliah mamiliah:
  1) Mambuek bid baru jo kuantitas nan labiah tinggi atau nilai muko nan labiah tinggi (atau kaduonyo) daripado bid nan sadang balansuang; yaitu '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Manggil bid tarakhia jo mangetik '[Call]'.

Jiko Anda manggil:
  - Jiko jumlah dadu nan cocok di antaro sadonyo dadu kurang daripado bid, pamain nan mambuek bid tarakhia kalah ciek dadu.
  - Lain daripado itu, pamain nan manggil kalah ciek dadu.
Pamain nan mancapai 0 dadu dieliminasi. Pamain nan tasiso tarakhia manang.

board.new_round:
Ronde baru - Dadu siso: {dice_summary}
Dadu kini adolah: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Pamain {current_player_id} manyabuik! Jumalah asli muko {face_value} adolah {count}, nan kurang dari {quantity}.
Pamain {loser_id} (pamain tarakhia manyabuik) kalah satu dadu.
call.caller_loses:
Pamain {current_player_id} manyabuik! Jumalah asli muko {face_value} adolah {count}, nan >= {quantity}.
Pamain {loser_id} (pamain manyabuik) kalah satu dadu.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Panggilan nan dibuek tanpa tawaran sabalunnyo.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Tindakan indak dikenal sabagai '[Bid: X, Y]' atau '[Call]' nan sah. Tindakan nan diajukan: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Kuantitas baru {new_quantity} labiah randah dari kuantan barek {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nilai nominal baru {new_face_value} labiah randah dari pado nilai nan ado kini ko {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Tawaran iko identik jo tawar-tawaran nan ado.

message.eliminated_invalid: Pamain {player_id} dibuang dek ulahrago nan indak sah.
